description: In front of you is an open shelf unit beside a toy dishwasher door, with several clear plastic food containers stacked inside and a green-lidded container on the middle shelf. The left hand stays low and mostly idle while the right hand reaches into the shelves and repeatedly lifts out individual containers—first a small one from the lower area, then the green-lidded container, then additional clear containers from the upper shelf—bringing each out to the right and setting them down to unstack them into a small pile on the tabletop.
